$ archo uninstall
uninstall: dry run, nothing changed
  accounts: forget account sessions before removing tools or data; external SteamCMD caches stay untouched
    forget      $ROOT/LocalAppData/RimArcho/accounts  — 忘记账户会话：删除站点会话与临时登录目录，并清理受管 SteamCMD 的已知认证缓存（所有缓存账户）；外部缓存不接管。不可恢复，不撤销其他设备。

    unlink      $ROOT/Steam/steamapps/common/RimWorld/Mods/_Archo_steamcmd_8888 → $ROOT/steamcmd/steamapps/workshop/content/294100/8888
  modsconfig: keep the ModsConfig.xml list of 1 user data folder without Archo Monitor and the mods only reached through a removed link; remove RimArcho's backup

    delete      $ROOT/LocalAppData/RimArcho/monitor/ArchoMonitor-0.9.0  <size>

$ archo uninstall --yes --dry-run
error: --yes runs it, --dry-run shows it: pick one
usage: archo uninstall [--dry-run] [--yes] [--keep-locked] [--locked-to <env>] [--remove-packs] [--packs-to <dir>] [--remove-saves] [--saves-to <dir>] [--remove-games] [--restore-modsconfig-backup] [--all]
[exit 2]
